messages:
incident-bot: ALERT • Dedicated VPC pool for tenant 'avalon' >98% GPU utilization, GPU queue latency 2200ms, active GPUs: 16/16, tenant usage: 95%.
alex_oncall: I'm on call. looking at dashboards now.
emma_sre: seeing sustained queue depth on worker-nodes-6..8. autoscaler shows "scale_attempt_failed: quota_limit" in logs.
raj_infra: confirmed. GCP quota throttle on project-redwood-avalon. autoscaler tried to request 4 more preemptible GPUs and got 403 QuotaExceeded.
luke_se: customer reported 503s for /v1/generate and increased tail latency. they're currently routing 100% to dedicated pool.
mia_cs: Avalon's SRE is online with our CS lead. they're seeing ~30% request failures for long-running chat sessions. we need to tell them plan ASAP.
alex_oncall: options: 1) trigger emergency burst override to add GPUs from shared reserve; 2) reroute new sessions to hosted API fallback with tokenized SLA; 3) enforce per-tenant throttling to preserve existing sessions. thoughts?
ops-lead: we have a documented emergency override for enterprise VPCs. requires approval from infra lead + cs ack. duration default 15m.
raj_infra: I can approve. If we add 4 GPUs from reserve it should drop queue latency under 200ms. runbook comment: "burst uses shared-reserve pool; billing flagged to finance later".
alex_oncall: mia_cs, can CS confirm customer acceptance of brief disruption during reroute if needed?
mia_cs: confirmed - Avalon prefers no reroutes if we can avoid it. they authorize emergency burst.
luke_se: while we scale, can we enable a temporary model fallback for chat-heavy endpoints to gpt-small-q4 to reduce per-token GPU pressure? config toggle: route /v1/chat -> model:gpt-small-q4 for tenant avalon.
emma_sre: I can flip a routing rule. quick patch:
```
route.add("/v1/chat", tenant="avalon", model="gpt-small-q4", sticky=false)
```
will only affect new sessions.
support-obs: traces show large KV cache warming spikes from some sessions; recommend clearing warm caches for idle sessions to free memory.
alex_oncall: doing sequence: 1) raj triggers burst, 2) emma applies routing toggle, 3) support clears caches, 4) monitor. executing now.
raj_infra: /ops/burst override --tenant avalon --gpus 4 --duration 900
ops-bot: ACTION LOGGED • Burst override requested by raj_infra: tenant=avalon gpus=4 duration=900s
ops-bot: BURST COMPLETED • 4 GPUs added to pool, new active GPUs: 20/20
emma_sre: routing rule applied. new sessions routed to gpt-small-q4.
support-obs: cache pruning done on nodes 6..8.
alex_oncall: observed GPU utilization down to 72% within 3m, queue latency 180ms, error rate down to 2%.
mia_cs: Avalon says errors stopped for new requests, minor impact reported but acceptable. customer engineer thanks the team.
ops-lead: creating follow-up: TRACKER-3456 - "VPC autoscaler quota fallback & burst runbook update" assigned to raj_infra+emma_sre.
emma_sre: will add extra telemetry: autoscaler error alerts -> page infra when quota errors appear.
alex_oncall: I'll close pager in 30m if metrics remain stable. next: retro and RCA.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED • Status: degraded->stable. Duration: 00:17:40. Reference: 1769999998
